_comment: Standard RNN-T transducer ASR (greek_asr.models.transducer), using the pure_pytorch_logspace loss backend. max_steps remains null until representative training-data measurements justify the budget; batch_size and gradient_accumulation_steps are provisional values to check in those measurements. See docs/SEQUENCE_MODELS.md.
architecture: RNN-T: unidirectional pyramidal LSTM encoder, LSTM prediction network, feed-forward joint network
primary_sources: Graves (2012), Sequence Transduction with Recurrent Neural Networks, arXiv:1211.3711
He et al. (2019), Streaming End-to-end Speech Recognition for Mobile Devices
